name: file-storage-browser
title: File Storage Browser
description: A cloud asset manager with folder directory hierarchy, file size badges, and selection controls.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Directory Navigation And File Selection: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
